english.title: Fail to produce a club premises certificate / certified copy - Licensing Act 2003
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person nominated in writing by the secretary of a club, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE CLUB..), which held a club premises certificate for **(..SPECIFY THE REGISTERED ADDRESS..), failed, without reasonable excuse, to produce the club premises certificate or a certified copy of it for examination when required by

(A)_[a constable]_
(B)_[an authorised person exercising powers under the Licensing Act 2003]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 94(9) and (10) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:

A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months
